title: Continents
source: CMap's `continent` key names the file (CMap::LoadKey, 0x893B0). CMap::AssignContinents (0x8F260) walks each continent's province list; a province already given a continent keeps the first and the game logs `Province #... assigned to multiple continents.`; a continent named `lake` makes its provinces landlocked water (FINDINGS-seaair.md section 4). The file's own grammar was not read.

file.desc: named lists of provinces; `lake` is special

patterns.desc: a continent; the name `lake` makes its provinces landlocked water
